title: Seoul stocks crash for 2nd day on AI rout after US midterms
caption:
South Korea's stock market faced a dramatic 20-minute suspension today as the KOSPI index plummeted. The crash followed US midterm results, sparking fears that new political leadership in key states could slow down the global AI infrastructure build-out.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul stocks crash for 2nd day on AI rout after US midterms
